snippet.title: The Granny Detective Society demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Play as a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the CIA… but with dentures). Investigate a suspicious neighborhood, deduce residents’ names and professions, and uncover secrets in this no-murder detective game.

The Granny Detective Society by @Team-Empreintes-Studio has an updated demo out!

The Granny Detective Society in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/the-granny-detective-society/
The Granny Detective Society on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240620/The_Granny_Detective_Society/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/

#thinkygames #puzzlegame #exclusive #trailer #indiegames #detectivegame
